capabilities: Track current, max, and temporary hit points with a color-coded HP bar
Apply damage and healing with resistance or vulnerability modifiers
Resolve Constitution concentration saves after taking damage
Undo the latest action from a five-entry combat log
Restore full HP with a long rest action
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track character hit points during D&D play, forcing players to track HP outside the vault.
summary: Sidebar panel that tracks D&D character hit points, temporary HP, damage modifiers, concentration saves, and a short combat log.
